title: Fatal aircraft mishap and four lost hours

tellings.quote: stands out as a story was that uh we had an aircraft mishap where um one of our pilots died.

plain: Greg Rogers, a former NASA doctor who served with the Third Attack Battalion, says an aircraft accident in the field killed one of the unit's pilots, and that the episode is tied to four hours no one could account for. Rogers tells Michels this as something he was there for. He tells it as the event from his service that stands out most, and as a hint that something unexplained happened in those missing hours.
